mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good way to help establish a personalized vaccination program for the species and area."
Consulting with a veterinarian is a good way to help establish a personalized vaccination program for the species and area.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a deviation from the normal and is revealed by changes in the animal."
Disease is a deviation from the normal and is revealed by changes in the animal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an innate or inborn ability to resist certain types of diseases and this immunity does not involve production of antibodies."
Natural immunity is an innate or inborn ability to resist certain types of diseases and this immunity does not involve production of antibodies.
fib: ______ is used for drugs in the gaseous state or volatile agents.
Pulmonary route (inhalation) This route is used for drugs in the gaseous state or volatile agents.
______ is an immunisation process using biological agents to induce protective effect against known disease agents in animals in order to prevent disease occurrence in the induced animals.
Vaccination is an immunisation process using biological agents to induce protective effect against known disease agents in animals in order to prevent disease occurrence in the induced animals.
